caseName: Weyerhaeuser Co. v. Lyman Lamb Co.
caseNameFull: Weyerhaeuser Co. v. Lyman Lamb Co. and Georgia-Pacific Corp. v. Lyman Lamb Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 456 U. S. 971.] Motion of respondents for relief from compliance with Rule 28.1 granted.

Justice White, Justice Powell, and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
